basis: Characteristic toxic axonal neuropathy and hair-follicle injury; common acute gastrointestinal symptoms alone do not establish direct mucosal injury.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea are characteristic, but symptoms alone do not establish common gastrointestinal tissue injury.

basis: Cutaneous lymphoma with defining circulating malignant T cells; hepatomegaly in 30-79% does not establish common hepatic infiltration or dysfunction.

decisions.hepatic: none: HPO hepatomegaly occurs in 30-79%, but enlargement alone does not establish hepatic infiltration or functional injury in at least 30%.

basis: Mitochondrial metabolic disorder; microcephaly 2/2, encephalopathy/seizures 1/2, and heart failure/pulmonary arterial hypertension 1/2. Hypotonia alone does not establish myopathy.

decisions.neurologic: involved: microcephaly in 2/2 and encephalopathy/seizures in 1/2 establish common CNS damage; the defining disease is mitochondrial metabolic deficiency.

basis: Pulmonary EBV-associated lymphoproliferation; CNS involvement ~30-40%. Skin infiltration ~30-40% omitted at cap in favor of severe CNS disease; grade-specific rates uncertain.

decisions.neurologic: involved: CNS infiltration occurs in approximately 30-40% of lymphomatoid granulomatosis overall; grade I-specific estimates are uncertain.
decisions.dermatologic: none at cap: skin infiltration occurs in approximately 30-40% overall; retain the more severe CNS involvement alongside the three primary axes.

basis: Intellectual disability and developmental delay in 7/7 define the syndrome; clinodactyly in 4/7 and tapered fingers in 3/7 do not establish impaired skeletal function.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: clinodactyly occurs in 4/7, but minor digit-shape variants without demonstrated functional impairment do not establish skeletal damage.

basis: Spotted-fever rickettsial infection directly targets vascular endothelium and causes small-vessel vasculitis; transient rash adds no dermatologic axis.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: endothelial infection and small-vessel vasculitis are the defining tissue pathology of spotted-fever rickettsiosis.

basis: Ectodermal sweat-gland, hair and dental defects with T-cell immunodeficiency; conical teeth in 1/1 and hypodontia are defining dental abnormalities. Organomegaly alone adds no axis.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: dental dysplasia is a defining component of hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia; teeth belong to this axis, with conical teeth in 1/1 and hypodontia reported.

basis: Tumor of parasympathetic carotid-body chemoreceptor paraganglia. Neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish endocrine-gland disease; carotid proximity adds no vascular axis.

decisions.neurologic: primary: the tumor originates in carotid-body parasympathetic paraganglia, part of the peripheral autonomic sensory system.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: the tumor arises in parasympathetic chemoreceptor tissue; neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish an endocrine-gland or metabolic disorder.

basis: Muscular dystrophy with defining conduction disease and cataracts (80-99% each); cognitive impairment 30-79%. Baldness omitted at cap; supplied hypogonadism frequency is 5-29%.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: arrhythmia and cardiac conduction disease are explicit defining manifestations; conduction abnormalities occur in 80-99%.
decisions.ocular: primary: cataract is an explicit defining manifestation, with posterior subcapsular cataract in 80-99%.

basis: Rett-like neurodevelopmental disorder; gastrointestinal functional impairment occurs in 30-79% and reflects persistent dysmotility. Central breathing abnormalities do not establish lung injury.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: HPO records gastrointestinal functional abnormality in 30-79%; persistent dysmotility constitutes loss of gut function, beyond feeding symptoms alone.
